component.name: Trackfecta
component.summary: Unofficial tray-first desktop client for Toggl Track

description.p: Trackfecta is a native Linux desktop client for Toggl Track, built with Tauri v2. It runs from the system tray and keeps time with little effort:

ul.li: Start and stop quick entries from the window, the tray, or a global shortcut
Resume yesterday's entry from the tray menu
Day-grouped entry list with offline cache
Idle detection with a keep, discard, or split dialog
API token stored in the system keyring, never on disk

description.p: Trackfecta is an independent, unofficial client. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Toggl OÜ. It talks to the public Toggl Track REST API with your own API token.
**Note:** On GNOME, the tray icon needs the AppIndicator shell extension to be installed on the host system.
Continue from a merged group row.

ul.li: The merged group row in the entry list has a Continue button that starts a new entry from that group

description.p: Organisation switching, entry grouping, and refresh fixes.

ul.li: Switch between the organisations on your account from Settings. A running timer keeps running across the switch
Same-day entries with the same description, project and client merge into one row, like the official Toggl clients
The day list and tray refresh after the machine resumes from sleep, so the headers always show the right day

description.p: Launch at login now works in the Flatpak build.

ul.li: Inside a Flatpak, the autostart toggle registers the real login entry through the XDG Background portal instead of writing a file the host session never reads
The portal starts the app minimized to the tray, like the other packaged builds
AppImage: uses the host Wayland libraries, so the window opens reliably on modern Wayland desktops
Snap: launcher entry and keyring guidance fixed
Full-size icons for the deb, rpm, and AppImage launchers
Quick entry start, stop, edit, and resume
Tray icon with live running time and today total
